notes.title: 🧸 Giant Problems Ahead: The Patapim Update Rolls Into Station
notes.content: [p][b]🧸 Giant Problems Ahead: The Patapim Update Rolls Into Station[/b][/p][p]The [b]BIGGEST[/b] update in [b]THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano[/b] history is approaching the platform, and it's bringing the legend of [b]Patapim[/b] with it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🗿 The giant awakens... and the mystery deepens[/b][/p][p]Something [b]BIG[/b] is coming to [b]THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano[/b] – and we mean [i]giant-sized[/i] big. The next update brings you face-to-face with the legend of [b]Patapim[/b], but this isn't just another stop on your journey. This is where the tracks lead to something much larger than expected.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🚂 New destination unlocked[/b] Explore a [b]brand-new area[/b] with more puzzles and encounters with famous characters who know more than they're letting on. Each conversation could be the key to understanding what really happened in these forgotten halls.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🧸 The case of the missing Lebabe Plushies[/b] Where did they go? Why are they gone? And what does the [b]haunting statue of BrrBrrPatapim[/b] have to do with their disappearance? Some mysteries are bigger than they appear, and this one might just change everything you thought you knew about the last station.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🏆 Three new achievements await the brave[/b] Only the most determined passengers will unlock all the secrets hidden within these ancient walls. Think you've mastered every corner of our world? Think again.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎮 But that's not all...[/b] We've hidden extra surprises throughout the update – easter eggs, secret interactions, and hidden dialogues that only the most curious explorers will discover. Every shadow could hide a new secret, every corner might reveal something unexpected.[/p][p][/p][p]The giant statue watches, the plushies have vanished, and famous faces are ready to share their darkest secrets. The tracks have led you this far, but are you prepared for where they're taking you next?[/p][p][/p][p][b]The legend of Patapim isn't just a story – it's a warning.[/b][/p][p][i]Do you dare to board the last train once again?[/i] 🚇[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Celebrating our first month! Play with a controller and soon on other devices
notes.content:
[h1][b]🥳 One month since launch![/b][/h1]

[b]Thank you for being part of this first month[/b].
At first, we didn’t think this project would need many updates, but you’ve enjoyed it so much that it motivates us to keep going.

It may seem short, but it’s been intense.
Thanks to everyone who played, left a review, shared a gameplay video, or sent us feedback.
[b]This game exists because of you.[/b]

We're working on new content to push the story further — and also to let you play anywhere 🤳.

[h2][b]🎮 Full controller support[/b][/h2]

You can now play [b]THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano[/b] with your favorite controller.
Yes, you asked for it. Yes, it’s finally here.

[h2][b]🎬 You can now skip the opening cutscene[/b][/h2]

[b]We know.[/b]
[b]Yes, we know.[/b]
You can now skip the first cutscene if you've memorized it (or if it just creeps you out 😨).

We’ve also made [b]general gameplay improvements[/b] — small but important — along with [b]subtle new interactions[/b] that enrich exploration.

We're also testing builds for macOS and Linux. Just a few details left to get them ready!

[b]Thanks for staying on board.[/b]
[b]And remember: if you’ve played, leave a review on Steam![/b]

notes.title: 🔧 Quality of life update
notes.content:
[h2][b]🚇 Small but necessary adjustments[/b][/h2]

A [b]quality of life update[/b] for THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano is coming soon.
It’s a subtle patch, yes… but one that will make everything feel smoother.

Small but meaningful improvements, new interactions, and a few details you'll be glad we added.

[h2][b]🔍 Still working on something big[/b][/h2]

This patch is just one more step.
[b]We’re working on a major content update[/b] that will expand the story, mechanics, and mysteries of the game.
We want returning to the station to be more unsettling… and unforgettable.

Thanks for staying on board.
And remember: [b]leave a review if you've played![/b]

notes.title: New shark update now available!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🚨 Our biggest update so far[/b][/h2]

[b]THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano[/b] receives a major update today that completely changes the game experience.
We’ve worked to make the mystery more engaging and the gameplay longer.
It’s time to return to the station... [b]because this time, there’s more to discover.[/b]

[h2][b]🦈 New canonical ending[/b][/h2]

You thought you understood it all. That the journey was over. But [b]something has changed[/b].

We’ve added new elements to deepen the game’s story. Our goal is to build a narrative that is both intriguing and entertaining.

And yes… [b]one of your favorite characters returns[/b] to leave their mark.

[h2][b]🏆 Achievements are here![/b][/h2]

[b]Unlock every achievement[/b] by revisiting the decisions, paths, and horrors you may have missed the first time.

Replay value: guaranteed.

[h2][b]🥚 More easter eggs[/b][/h2]

New [b]easter eggs[/b] are hidden for the most observant players.
Some offer clues, others are just… fun.

[h2][b]✍️ Leave your review[/b][/h2]

[b]We invite you to replay THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano[/b] and discover everything we’ve prepared.

[b]Enjoyed the experience?[/b] Leave us a review on Steam — it really helps and gives the game more visibility.

--

[b]The train is in motion. Are you sure you want to get back on?[/b]
[b]Remember to get off before the last station.[/b]

notes.title: How far would you go for a piece of candy? Stay tuned this May 30th.
notes.content:
[h2][b]🍫 Something sweet… and dangerous[/b][/h2]

How far would you go for a simple piece of candy? On May 30th, you’ll find out.

We’re preparing a major update for [b]THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano[/b]—one that not only improves the experience but rewrites parts of the story. We want the mystery to feel darker, deeper, and to leave you with more questions than answers.

[h2][b]🛠️ Final touches and unlockable achievements[/b][/h2]

We’re finishing the last details to include [b]achievements[/b] in this new version. You’ll be able to collect them all very soon.

[h2][b]🚇 Come back… if you dare[/b][/h2]

Are you ready to relive the fear of the last train?
The update arrives on [b]May 30th[/b].

[b]Prepare your senses… and remember to get off before the last station.[/b]

notes.title: 🎉 Over 1,000 Copies Sold! A Big Update Is Coming
notes.content:
[h2][b] Thank you for joining us on this journey! [/b][/h2]

When we started working on THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano, we were just 3 people with one idea: to make a short, intense, and terrifying game. No budget, no publisher—just the desire to tell an unsettling story that would linger in your mind.

Today, we can only express our deepest gratitude for the worldwide reception. [b]We've now sold over 1,000 copies![/b] We watch every gameplay, every comment, every reaction with a mix of joy and disbelief. Thank you for uploading your videos, sharing your theories, and getting scared with us. There’s nothing more rewarding than seeing something we made with love come to life on your screens.

[h2][b]🚇 Next station: a major update[/b][/h2]

We're already working on an update to expand and polish the experience. Here’s what’s coming:

🕯️ [b]More story, more questions:[/b] We know some parts of the lore are confusing. We want the story to be as coherent as it is unsettling, planting mysteries we may explore in future updates.
🎮 [b]Improved gameplay:[/b] Even though the game is simple, we can still refine and expand some mechanics. Community suggestions are already in development.
🌑 [b]More immersive atmosphere:[/b] We’re improving the lighting and visual elements to make the experience even more intense and immersive.
🏆 [b]Achievements![/b] Yes, we love them too. The next update will include unlockable achievements based on your in-game actions.

Thank you for being here. Thank you for believing in this small indie project.

[b]And remember... get off before the last station.[/b]

tags.feature: 🏆 [b]Achievements![/b] Yes, we love them too. The next update will include unlockable achievements based on your in-game actions.

notes.title: Launch Day Is Here!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🚇 The train leaves TODAY! The Last Train: Baquedano is now live[/b][/h2]

The big day is here! After countless late-night coffees, self-induced scares, and tons of demo feedback, we’re opening the doors of the last station to everyone. We’re polishing the final details to make sure every dark corridor, every creak, and every surprise keeps you on the edge of your seat—and makes even the brave jump.

[b]What are we tightening up in these final hours?[/b]
[list]
[*] More content so it’s not just a sprint. A deeper story? You’ll have to uncover it.  
[*] Dynamic-lighting tweaks for an even heavier atmosphere.  
[*] Bug fixes.  
[*] Final pass on text and subtitles in all supported languages.  
[/list]

[b]We want to hear you scream![/b]  
If you stream or upload a video, share it—we love seeing your reactions (and it helps us improve). Drop suggestions and bugs too; we’ll keep rolling out quick patches.

Thanks for joining us on this ride. Grab your headphones, turn off the lights and… [i]all passengers must disembark[/i].  
See you on the last train.
